groups.title: Florida — Kennedy Space Center & Cape Canaveral

sites.name: Pad 1 (Pad A / OLP-1)
sites.role: Original orbital launch mount; Mechazilla tower hosted early booster catches (e.g. B12, B14, B15). Being upgraded toward Pad 2 V3 chopstick and catch-pin standards.
sites.last_activity: Chopstick and Pad 1 hardware demolition/upgrade work reported in late 2026 ahead of V3 ops.
sites.notes: Recent integrated Starship flights (including Flight 14, 28 Sep 2026) launched from Pad 2, not Pad 1. Pad 1 teardown includes chopstick sled removal and catch-pin geometry updates per public reporting.

sources.title: NSF — Pad 1 teardown ahead of revamp (Starbase Update)

sites.name: Pad 2 (Pad B / OLP-2)
sites.role: Primary Starship/Super Heavy launch site; V3 chopsticks, catch tower, and pad systems. Flight 15 (B-22/S-42) planned return-to-launch-site catches of booster and ship.
sites.last_activity: Starship Flight 14 launched 28 Sep 2026 (B-21/S-41); booster splashdown in Gulf (no catch). Booster 22 on pad Nov 2026 for Flight 15 catch prep.
sites.notes: SpaceX official Flight 15 page describes first dual catch attempt at Starbase. Pad 2 tower oriented southeast per NSF reporting.

sites.name: KSC LC-39A — Starship pad
sites.role: East Coast Starship launch complex at historic Pad 39A; launch tower with chopsticks planned for Super Heavy and Ship catch (return-to-launch-site). Expected first Starship launch: Flight 16.
sites.last_activity: Tower vent, deluge, and pad system tests reported Sep–Oct 2026; reinforced catch roof installed Oct 2026.
sites.notes: NET ~10 Dec 2026 cited in FAA planning conference reporting (preliminary). Ships likely arrive by barge without local static-fire stands; boosters can test on-pad.

sources.title: Florida Spaceflight — FAA Dec 2026 planning targets

sites.name: CCSFS SLC-37A — Starship pad
sites.role: First of two planned Starship pads at SLC-37; tower stacking, flame trench, tank farm foundations. FAA/DAF EIS authorizes launches and RTLS/ocean landings pending license.
sites.last_activity: Tower module stacking and launch mount work reported mid–late 2026; chopsticks/carriage staged on site.
sites.notes: Not expected online for near-term flights; LC-39A is the near-term Florida launch site.

sources.title: FAA — Starship at Cape Canaveral SLC-37

sites.name: CCSFS SLC-37B — Starship pad (planned)
sites.role: Second planned Starship pad at SLC-37 complex; groundwork reported while SLC-37A leads.
sites.last_activity: Groundwork and layout prep reported 2026 alongside SLC-37A build-out.
sites.notes: Environmental approval covers up to two pads; operational date unknown.

sites.name: Louisiana — operational Starship sites
sites.role: No confirmed Starship launch or landing site operating in Louisiana as of 11 Nov 2026.
sites.notes: SpaceX has announced a future “Starbase, Louisiana” Gulf Coast spaceport (Vermilion Parish / Pecan Island area) on spacex.com — a long-term proposal, not an active pad. Offshore Phobos/Deimos oil-rig conversion work occurred in Pascagoula, Mississippi (2020–2023) and rigs were sold; that was not a Louisiana landing site. FAA/DAF Florida EIS documents discuss Gulf of Mexico booster/ship landing options for Cape ops, not a Louisiana pad.
